dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.heroTitle: Turn your fridge into a smart nutrition plan.
dashboard.heroSubtitle: Discover personalized recipes based on your real ingredients, adjusted to your nutritional needs and physical goal.
dashboard.featureSmartMenusBody: Generate culinary proposals based on scanned products.
dashboard.featureSmartMenusExpand: Use the Recipes section to capture your fridge with the camera, confirm detected products, and generate menus aligned with your stock. You can run a quick flow or a full pipeline and save what you cook to your daily log.
dashboard.featureNutritionBody: Track calories and macronutrients in real time with personalized recommendations.
dashboard.featureNutritionExpand: Your profile sets calorie and macro targets. The dashboard summarizes what you consumed today, what you burned with exercise, and what is left—so you can adjust meals without guessing.
dashboard.featureProgressBody: See the evolution of your intake, exercise, and weight in one dashboard.
dashboard.featureProgressExpand: History brings together weight trends, advanced charts, and your logged activity over time. Use it to review habits and see how your plan evolves beyond a single day.
dashboard.profileMissingBody: Profile is not configured yet. Please complete your profile to start tracking calories and macros.
dashboard.recipesUsedTodaySubtitle: Click a recipe to see details or remove it.

auth.privacyConsentRequired: You must accept the privacy and biometric processing terms to register.
auth.privacyCheckboxPrefix: I accept the processing of my biometric data according to the
auth.privacyModalTitle: Privacy Policy and Data Consent (Art. 9 GDPR)
auth.privacyModalBody1: In accordance with Article 9 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), data relating to weight, height, age, and food allergies are classified as special categories of data due to their direct link to health and biometrics.
auth.privacyModalBody2: By checking this box, you grant your explicit consent for the platform to process these variables for the sole purpose of calculating your metabolic requirements and optimizing menu generation through the Artificial Intelligence pipeline. Your access credentials and civil identity remain strictly isolated from the language models.
auth.privacyModalBody3: The system interacts exclusively with enterprise-grade commercial APIs that guarantee data encryption and explicitly prohibit the use of your nutritional data for retraining external models. You can revoke this consent by deleting your account at any time from the settings section.
